title: promote-release.mjs --notes-from <sha>: read release notes from a descendant of the tag commit whose net range is CHANGELOG.md plus .quest/ only (DEC-204 (3)/(3a), used once for 0.14.1)
description: opum-doc DEC-204 (3), ruling A (relay 894). The v0.14.1 tag (peels to 053d8595) has no 0.14.1 heading in CHANGELOG.md, and promote-release.mjs reads release notes at the commit the tag peels to (QCLI-398, QCLI-407), so it would refuse. #632 fixed the heading forward on dev. This adds a narrow --notes-from <sha> so the 0.14.1 promote reads only the ## <version> section at <sha>. The tag, the receipt and the rc bytes stay bound to 053d8595. It is used once for 0.14.1 and the record says so. Sensitive: release tooling; one Opus unit by ref, then the ODOC-484 land on the leader word. The 0.14.1 promote runs from dev checkout whose package.json reads 0.14.1, because promote takes its version from package.json and binds the bundle to the tag peel, not HEAD.

acceptanceCriteria.text: promote-release.mjs --notes-from <sha> accepts a sha only when it descends from the commit the version tag peels to, is reachable from origin/dev, AND its NET range tag..sha touches only CHANGELOG.md (plain modification, exactly once) plus paths under .quest/ (DEC-204 (3a)); it reads only the ## <version> section at <sha>.

A descendant whose net range is CHANGELOG.md plus .quest/ only is accepted; a descendant that touches any other file is refused naming that file; a non-descendant and a sha not reachable from dev are refused by name; each case has a test, and the refusal tests go red when the check is removed.
Without --notes-from the notes are still read at the tag peel commit, unchanged, and the bundle, receipt and rc bytes stay bound to the tag peel when the flag is used.

The PR carries the 0.14.1 promote dry run from the dev tip showing the bundle bound to the 053d8595 peel and the notes taken from the #632 commit, and the release record says the flag is used once, for 0.14.1.

implementationNotes: DEC-204 (3a), opum-doc ruling A (relay 896, via leader 2026-10-20). Mutation: dropping the .quest allowance turned the accept-with-tracker test, the real-range accept and the real-range refusal red (I predicted the first two; the refusal asserts .quest is not blamed, which also fails when the allowance is gone). AC3 real dry run still waits on the pair receipt.

CLAIMS
1. Net-range allow-list: CONFIRMED by reading.
   - The allow-list is github-release.mjs:478-503.
   - `underTracker` is a literal `startsWith(".quest/")`.
   - A file passes if it is CHANGELOG.md, or if it is under .quest/ and either has no previous_filename or its previous_filename is also under .quest/.
   - Everything else is listed in `others` and refused by name (:490-494).
   - CHANGELOG.md must appear exactly once, with status `modified` and no previous_filename (:495-503).
   - An empty, missing or 300+ file list is refused at :466-471. So is a range touching only .quest/, because CHANGELOG is absent; the test is at test:246.
   - Edge cases, all refused:
     - `.questx/`, `.questions/`, `x/.quest/` and bare `.quest` (test:218-229).
     - A rename src -> .quest/ (test:231-242), because previous_filename is outside .quest.
     - A rename .quest -> src, a src deletion, and a copy from src, because their filename or previous_filename is outside .quest.
     - A CHANGELOG -> .quest rename, which fails twice: as an other file, and because CHANGELOG is then absent.
     - A null previous_filename. It fails closed because the check uses `=== undefined`.
   - `.quest/../src/x` passes startsWith lexically, but git refuses `..` path components, so the compare API cannot emit one. That is a nit, not a hole.
   - Deleting or adding a .quest/ record is accepted. That is intended.
2. Reachability via dev...sha: CONFIRMED by construction (:443-465). Only `behind` or `identical` accepts, and only an ancestor of dev, or dev itself, can return either.
   - A fork-only or dangling sha either fails to resolve, which the catch at :452 refuses, or comes back `ahead` or `diverged`, which is also refused.
   - So GitHub's fork resolution changes only which message the operator sees, never the outcome.
   - Both network reads fail closed. Errors are caught, including a JSON.parse throw inside the try, and every status check is a strict equality.
   - Nit: the ref is the bare name `dev`. If a tag named `dev` ever existed, how GitHub resolves the ambiguity is UNVERIFIED.
3. Real-range accept, and mutation with 3 red instead of 2: the logic is CONFIRMED, the execution is UNVERIFIED.
   - The third red is the real-range refusal test. Its assertion `not.toContain(".quest/tasks/QCLI-499.json")` (test:308) fails once the allowance is gone, because .quest files join the blamed list.
   - That is informative over-specification: the refusal test also pins the allowance. It is not coupling that hides anything, and the writer's implementation note says the same.
   - On reading, the other refusal tests stay green under that mutation. That fits exactly 3 red.
4. Hand-cut repair hint: CONFIRMED (promote-release.mjs:729-733, used at :1103).
   - It keys on `notesFrom !== undefined`. Any defined notesFrom that reaches :1103 has passed notesCommitFrom, which refuses sha === tag, so this is equivalent to notesCommit != peel.
   - There is a caveat; see Minor 1.
5. Empty --notes-from refused: CONFIRMED.
   - An unquoted empty variable is dropped by the shell, so flag() throws "requires a value" (:740-741).
   - A quoted `""` reaches the 40-hex refusal (github-release.mjs:406), which the test covers at test:149.
   - :916 is now `!== undefined`.
6. Stale text fixed, no version pin: PARTLY REFUTED.
   - No pin: CONFIRMED. A grep finds no version-equality guard anywhere in scripts/.
   - Stale text: the code comments and messages are fixed (github-release.mjs:294, :305, :392-398; promote-release.mjs:53-54, :912). These still say CHANGELOG-only:
     - test/qcli515-notes-from.test.ts:10, "only to a CHANGELOG-only descendant".
     - .quest/tasks/QCLI-515.json: the title ("CHANGELOG-only descendant"), AC0 ("its diff against that commit touches CHANGELOG.md alone") and AC1 ("a descendant that touches any other file is refused").

FINDINGS
Blocker: none.

Major:
- M1. QCLI-515's AC0, AC1 and title contradict the shipped behaviour (DEC-204 (3a) accepts .quest/**).
  - AC0 cannot be checked truthfully as written.
  - The writer should amend them through `quest`, with the full AC list and --if-revision, before finalization.
  - This blocks checking AC0 and AC1. It does not block the code.

Minor:
1. The hand-cut hint (promote-release.mjs:732) drops the host pin. The tool uses `-R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli` (github-release.mjs:16-17, :233), but the hint's `gh release create` does not.
   - It also says `--notes-file <that section>` without saying BODY ONLY. The tool writes `section.body` (:574), and later checks compare normalised bodies (:131, :285). A hand cut that includes the `## 0.14.1` line would make every later preflight refuse with "notes differ".
   - Suggested hint: `gh release create v0.14.1 -R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli --verify-tag --title "Quest CLI 0.14.1" --notes-file <the section body, without its ## heading> --latest`.
   - Not blocking: it is printed only after `latest` has moved, and the operator does the cut by hand.
2. The "real range" tests replay a projection, not raw API output.
   - Both fixtures carry `commits[].subject`, `readAt` and a relative `url`, which the compare API does not return. The refusal fixture has no additions or deletions, while the accept fixture does.
   - The fields the gate reads (filename, status, previous_filename) are plausible.
   - realRange mocks dev...sha as `behind` for BOTH shas (test:281-282). For b1f173c0, a PR-branch head that is not on dev, a live run would refuse at reachability first, and the file-naming assertions would not apply. So "real range" covers the file list only, not the end-to-end refusal.
   - The test comment "not typed by hand" (:263-266) overstates this; "projected from the API" is accurate.
3. test:10 is stale header text (see claim 6).

Nit:
- test:210-212: the rename fixture's names are swapped (filename `old`, previous `new`). Harmless.
- test:259: `toContain("CHANGELOG.md")` is weak, because every refusal detail contains that string. Assert "must be modified" for the absent, added, removed and renamed cases.
- promote-release.mjs:924: the log line reads "a descendant of the tag commit (CHANGELOG.md plus .quest/ only) 053d859 (--notes-from)". The parenthetical splits "tag commit" from its sha.
- NET semantics are as intended. The three-dot compare with status `ahead` makes `files` the net tag..sha diff, so a src change followed by its revert nets out and passes. That is what "NET" in (3a) means. It is harmless, because only the CHANGELOG.md section at the sha is read, and the bundle, receipt and rc stay bound to the peel.
- docs/log.md picked up two unrelated lines (QCLI-491 #600, QCLI-509 #624). That is the append direction, which is benign.

AC3 READINESS: the code path is ready. A dry run with `--notes-from ce33f6d50cd193d2673ceede40fc4e89d5549c99` will run both live compares through notesCommitFrom before any write. It waits only on the pair receipt, and it is the first time the dev-reachability read meets the real API.
